item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. Because the islands form a protected channel, the water remains remarkably calm and sheltered from large ocean swells. This visual navigation removes…

item.title: What’s a Cabin Cruise? Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
item.description: Imagine waking up to the sound of water gently lapping against the hull, stepping outside, and diving straight into a clear, turquoise ocean. For a long time, enjoying a holiday like this meant you either needed a lifetime of sailing experience or the budget to rent a whole private vessel with a captain. Now, travelers can book a cabin cruise and experience the magic of a sailing vacation to an exotic destination for the price of a single hotel room. Even better, sailing experience is not required. You simply book your cabin, step aboard, and leave the work to the crew on board the yacht. Before you pack your bags and head for the marina, here is everything you need to know about this effortless way to explore the world. What Is a Cabin Cruise? A cabin cruise, also called a by-the-cabin sailing charter , is a style of travel where you rent a private stateroom or cabin on a yacht. The rest of the vessel is shared with a small group of like-minded travelers, so you have opportunities to socialize in between exploring islands and relaxing in your room. Every cabin charter trip features a carefully planned route, shared communal spaces, delicious meals, and a professional crew to run the ship. It’s an easy way to dip your toes into the yachting lifestyle. What Is a Cabin Charter Like? The entire travel process is designed to be stress-free from the moment you book your cabin cruise vacation to the day you head home. Choosing Your Destination and Dates Your journey begins by selecting where you want to sail and picking the dates that fit your schedule. These trips follow set itineraries, which you can view ahead of time. This way, you can see which ports you’ll visit and plan ahead of time. Arrival and Boarding When you arrive at the marina base, the crew will welcome you aboard and show you to your private stateroom. After a quick safety briefing and an introduction to the yacht, the captain casts off the lines and sets sail. Your Cruise Each day follows a relaxing rhythm of sailing, swimming, exploring hidden coves, and enjoying fresh meals on deck. While the captain handles the sailing, you share the spacious decks with your fellow passengers. Do You Need Sailing Experience? With this type of sailing vacation, no experience is required. You do not need to know how to tie a single knot, read a navigation chart, or handle a steering wheel. The price of your cabin includes the services of the captain and crew. They take care of navigation, weather tracking, anchoring, and all daily shipboard operations. The only thing you need to do the entire week is relax and have fun. What’s Included in a Cabin Yacht Charter? Inclusions vary based on the package you choose and the company you book with. Premium options, such as Dream Yacht ’s cabin cruises, typically include: A private, comfortable double cabin with its own bathroom Access to all shared yacht spaces, like the forward trampolines, salon, and sun decks The full services of a professional captain and cook Onboard water toys, which may include things like snorkeling gear, paddleboards, and kayaks Before booking, be sure to check the trip details to confirm inclusions and what you might need to cover during your cruise. Food, Beverages, and Culinary Options Many packages offer a half-board plan, which includes select meals such as breakfast and lunch. With half-board options, you may dine ashore at ports where you drop anchor. Other packages feature a full-board plan, which means breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included. Optional Excursions and Extras Depending on where you are sailing, you might have the option to add on excursions like guided island hikes and historical tours. It is always a good idea to check your specific package details before booking, so you know exactly what is covered and what extras you might want to explore. item.title: Quitting Corporate Life To Sail Crewed Charter In The BVIs
item.description: Be the first to charter Luna , our new 45ft Lagoon 450S, which arrives in the British Virgin Islands in March 2019. Luna’s captain and hostess, Nim and Fabiola, are experts in the BVI’s uncrowded beaches, quiet anchorages and premium dive locations. They take delivery of Luna in the fall and will be ready for March 2019. Luna sleeps six guests in three full-sized queen cabins and you can book now for 10% off March and April 2019 bookings . We chatted to them about their connection with the Caribbean, sailing epiphanies and why it’s all about the detail… From diving to skipper qualifications Nim is a United States Coast Guard certified captain and an experienced PADI divemaster. He worked in the IT industry before sailing full time. He’s been on boats since a young boy and is passionate about life at sea, sailing extensively in Europe and the Caribbean, including the BVIs. He’s experienced in open water and has crossed the Mediterranean, Aegean, Adriatic and Andaman Sea, as well as sailing transatlantic from Europe to the US. He has endless stories and is naturally hospitable and welcoming. Nim said: “I grew up next to the sea and was always on boats as a child. I traveled to Thailand as a young man, got my diving certificates and worked for a year as a divemaster sailing the Similan Islands. “One afternoon I was resting on deck, enjoying the atmosphere and magic of nature when a beautiful yacht appeared with a couple on board. I had an epiphany and realised that sailing my own yacht is what I wanted to do. When I returned home I got a job in the IT industry to fund my sailing passion and resumed my highly demanding offshore skipper certification.” When your heart tells you to sail “In 2005, I got my own boat and I keenly remember the maiden voyage and the feeling of untying the lines and sailing by myself to Greece and Turkey. Of course, I had sailed many times on a charter with friends and was also a member of a sailing club, but this was the first time on my own boat. I sailed in the Mediterranean often, down to the Suez Canal and into the Red Sea. “The time came when I realized I had to do what I love, which was sailing and diving. We only live once, so I quit 25 years in the IT industry and went sailing. Two years ago, I picked up a boat in Europe, sailed across the Mediterranean and the Atlantic to St. Lucia to find adventure. “I continued to Puerto Rico where I met my wife and Luna’s hostess, Fabiola, and we sailed together to Turks and Caicos Islands and the Bahamas. We spent seven months sailing the Caribbean, including two months in the BVIs, USVIs and Spanish VIs. We have been doing crewed charters for a while on our sailing yacht and we enjoy it very much. We love hosting, entertaining, traveling and sailing so why not do this full time? We decided to buy a newer and bigger luxury yacht and we named her Luna.” An authentic connection to the BVIs Fabiola was raised among a family of serious cooks in the Caribbean and she began cooking from the age of eight when she was given her first recipe book. She loves to combine fresh, local produce with international cuisine she has experienced while traveling the world. Her catering experience includes exclusive parties and corporate events. Fluent in English and Spanish and even some French, she grew up on sailboats and holds a Master Captain license from the United States Coast Guard. Creating the perfect atmosphere on board is something she excels at. Fabiola said: “My dad and uncles had sailboats and I sailed with them around the Caribbean from the age of four. At weekends and in the summer, we’d head to BVIs, St. Thomas and St. John. As an adult, I would sail over to BVIs with friends, it is a very popular vacation destination for boaters and a personal favorite. “My family has a strong connection to the BVIs and we’ve supported and watched the islanders work hard to bring tourism back this year. Local people are happy again and the islands are as spectacular as ever, th…

item.title: Four Places You Can Rediscover the True Spirit of Adventure
item.description: For your next vacation, turn up the dial on adventure by handing over your itinerary research to us. When you book one of our yacht charter packages, you’ll enjoy photo-worthy highlights, exciting excursions, delicious cuisine and memorable experiences carefully selected by our destination specialists. In your downtime you can relax on a premium yacht with spacious lounge and deck areas before retreating to your private double cabin with its own bathroom. There are +15 destinations to choose from for our boat charter vacations , including the Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Pacific, Asia and Mediterranean. You’ll get to make new like-minded friends as you set off on an experience of a lifetime while our captain and chef will look after you. Get to know our latest routes… Extended vacation in the Grenadines Following the popularity of our Dream Grenadines premium 8 day charter , we’ve listened to requests for an extended tour of the Grenadines and introduced our new Dream Grenadines Premium 11 day charter . Your vacation will stop by: Martinique Bequia Mustique Tobago Cays and the marine park Petite St. Vincent Morpion Mayreau Palm Island Union St. Vincent Canouan Saint Lucia Saint Anne Optional excursions include: Mustique island tour and swim at Macaroni beach, lobster BBQ at Tobago Cays and visit to a local bar to hear a steel band, tour of St. Vincent and swim under a cascade of water, tour of St. Lucia including volcano crater, sulfur springs and botanical gardens. The Grenadines is such a wonderful part of the world with much to see and do without traveling far. Get your Caribbean sun booked in for this year and then all you have to do is check out the flights and pack your bags. Our new treat in Tahiti We’ve been offering French Polynesia by the cabin charters for a while with our Papeete 11 day charter , Huahine 4 day charter and Bora Bora 4 days and 8 day charters . New for 2018, we’ve added our Rangiroa Dream 6 day charter . Now you can explore Tahiti’s Tuamotus archipelago with its sandy motus, coral gardens and bounty of marine life to snorkel. During your vacation, you will discover: Mahanahana for kayaking and snorkeling Kauraufara fishing village and shell beach Sables Rose and coral garden Motu Teu and Bird Island with its thousands of birds Otepipi, a deserted village Motu Faama Blue lagoon and marine life Tiputa Pass and dolphin watching Tahiti is a special place full of romance where you can enjoy peace and quiet away from crowds and let us spoil you. New Cabin Charters in the Bahamas We’ve recently announced our new Exumas Dream 8 day charter from Nassau. It’s just a short hop before you hit the first of the Exumas cays where you’ll be met with white-sand beaches, surprising wildlife, protected marine reserves, Hollywood movie sets and even a former drug baron’s hideout. Your charter package includes visiting: Palm cay Highbourne Cay Allen Cay Warderick Wells Cay & Exuma Cays Land & Sea Park Staniel Cay Big Major Spot Bay with the swimming pigs Thunderball grotto Shroud Cay Norman’s Cay This region is famous for its stromatolite reefs, some of the oldest living examples on earth, as well as coral reefs teeming with tropical fish. Relax in the Balearic Islands If you want a European experience, head to Mallorca for our Palma Dream 8 day charter . You’ll find a relaxed pace of life, fantastic weather (with 300 sunny days annually) and a tour of the archipelago off Spain’s Iberian peninsula with 500km of coastline. Your cruise will include: Palma Cala Portal Vells Cala Pi Colonia Sant Jordi Cala Figuera Porto Petro Cala Santanyi Cabrera Es Trenc Beach Sa Rapita You’ll find golden beaches, medieval history, gothic cathedrals, quaint fishing ports and clear waters that are perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Learn more Take a look at our by the cabin charters , or get in touch with our team. Email us at [email protected] or give us a call at 855.650.8902. Share: Link Copied to Clipboard
